subject.title: fix: harden recovered meeting browser sessions

question: Should shared meeting talk-back intentionally fail closed whenever microphone state is unknown, even if that can prevent an otherwise connected session from becoming speech-ready?
rationale: The merged extraction described the previous unknown-state behavior as an established compatibility contract, while this PR deliberately reverses it across every meeting adapter; tests establish mechanics but cannot determine the intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Adopt strict readiness with proof
options.body: Keep unknown microphone state blocked, but require cross-adapter evidence that supported talk-back flows eventually report explicit unmuted state and recover through the retry path.

options.title: Preserve unknown-state compatibility
options.body: Retain the prior permissive behavior until each supported platform can guarantee reliable microphone-state observation.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict readiness with proof
recommendation.body: Keep unknown microphone state blocked, but require cross-adapter evidence that supported talk-back flows eventually report explicit unmuted state and recover through the retry path.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the shared runtime and documented both the prior compatibility position and this follow-up policy change.
